Harbour is a global design brand specializing in luxury outdoor furniture. The Junior Shopify Developer / Storefront Manager will support the operation, maintenance, and improvement of Shopify storefronts by managing product data, maintaining applications, updating themes, supporting integrations, and producing e-commerce reports.
Furniture
Responsibilities
Maintain and audit product data across the Shopify catalog (titles, descriptions, variants, images, pricing, collections)
Manage metafields and metadata structures to support merchandising, SEO, and app functionality
Ensure data consistency between Shopify and connected systems (ERP, PIM, etc.)
Perform general Shopify storefront maintenance, including monitoring app health, resolving broken links/pages, and troubleshooting storefront issues
Support and maintain third-party Shopify apps and their configurations
Make Shopify theme edits and updates (Liquid, HTML/CSS/JS) for layout, content, and functionality changes
Maintain internal documentation for storefront configurations, processes, and troubleshooting guide
Build and maintain recurring reports on storefront performance, product data health, and general e-commerce metrics
Support ad hoc reporting requests from marketing, operations, and leadership
Assist with maintaining integrations between Shopify and other business systems (ERP, order management, marketing platforms)
Exposure to or interest in Node.js is a plus — candidates comfortable reading/writing basic middleware code, working with REST APIs, or supporting webhook-based integrations will have opportunity to grow into this responsibility
Support troubleshooting of data sync issues between Shopify and connected platforms

Comfortable navigating Shopify Admin, product/inventory management, and basic Liquid templating
Familiarity with metafields, metaobjects, and how Shopify data structures work
Strong attention to detail — comfortable working in spreadsheets and data sets to identify and fix inconsistencies
Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
Ability to write clear documentation and communicate technical issues to non-technical stakeholders
Organized, self-directed, and comfortable managing multiple ongoing maintenance tasks
Preferred
Experience with Node.js or general backend/API development
Exposure to ERP systems (NetSuite or similar) or middleware/integration tools
Familiarity with NetSuite RESTlets or SuiteScript
Experience with IPaaS Tools ( Celigo )
Experience with reporting/BI tools
